children: UAE-based Royal Development Holding, a subsidiary of Emirates Stallions Group (ESG), has launched the second phase of its 1.45 billion UAE dirhams ($395 million) Radisson Residences Al Reem Island development in Abu Dhabi.

Phase Two introduces the project's third tower, comprising 437 furnished branded residences, including studios and one-bedroom apartments, as well as a limited number of two-bedroom townhouses, according to a stock exchange statement filed by parent firm ESG on Tuesday.
The furnished units are intended to be rental-ready upon handover.

Launched in December 2025, Radisson Residences Al Reem Island comprises three towers on a shared podium. Each tower includes a promenade level, ground floor, four podium levels, an amenities floor and 24 residential floors. The overall development offers studios, one- to three-bedroom apartments and two- and four-bedroom townhouses.

Royal Development Holding is also developing the AED 1 billion Rotana Residences – Al Reem Island project in Abu Dhabi. The two-tower development comprises 439 residences, including 197 units in the North Tower and 242 in the South Tower. The unit mix ranges from studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments to duplex penthouses.
Construction of both towers were scheduled to start in the second quarter of 2026, with completion expected in the fourth quarter of 2028.

Royal Development Holding was established in June 2025 as a luxury real estate platform dedicated to the ESG’s growing portfolio of high‑end projects. The company is also developing the AED 1.6 billion Seamont Autograph Collection Residences by Marriott on Al Reem Island in collaboration with SAAS Properties. The project features nearly 500 residential units, including 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, duplexes, 3- to 4-bedroom townhouses, and penthouses, and is slated for completion by the fourth quarter of 2027.

title: Royal Development Holding launches Phase 2 of $395mln Radisson Residences on Al Reem Island
